title: Pawn shop trading menu
summary: Trade with Rusty Hogg using a two-pane buy and sell menu.
notes: Show your inventory on the left and shop stock on the right as inventory-style cards with model previews, prices and Buy/Sell buttons.
Buy guns and matching ammo, including the MP5, M4A4 and AK-47.
Frame the shop in dark metal and aged brass with the Prawn crate emblem.
Center a Nothing to sell message when the inventory contains no pawnable items.
Sell selected pawnable materials and valuables; weapons, ammo and clothing are not accepted.
Validate proximity and ownership on the server and reserve pending sales to prevent duplicate payouts.
